← Magic Squares LabIntroduction

A course for curious beginners.

You need basic arithmetic and a willingness to try things. By the end of Chapter 3, you will have built odd- and even-order squares and tested transformations of completed squares.

Chapters 4–5 explore components and pictures; Chapters 6–7 branch into other shapes and history. Chapters 8–9 go deeper into dimensions and research. Each lesson has a short checkpoint, with further practice optional.

For a historical starting point, visit Lo Shu or Dürer’s engraving, then return here.

Your completed home puzzle is carried into this lesson. Its check is already earned; you can inspect the lines or continue.
